```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Universal daycare, eldercare and paid family leave would be provided.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All citizens would have equal rights.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Currently, millions of citizens in the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, overseas territories and Native American tribes do not have the ability to elect their own congressional representatives.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current racialized system of unequal justice would be replaced by a system featuring citizen review boards with real authority of both the police and court systems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The use of prisons to regulate behavior, which disproportionately affects communities of color and the poor, would be replaced with a system that decriminalizes a wide range of offenses, particularly nonviolent drug-related offenses.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A system would combine full services to victims with restorative justice, mental health care and various forms of counseling to help people find productive ways to move forward after committing serious crimes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Racial and ethnic and sex and gender-based oppressions may well continue in a socialist society.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Programs to dismantle the privileges associated with whiteness, maleness and heteronormativity would have to be developed.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Anti-discrimination policies in the workplace and in social organizations would have to be intensified.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democratic socialism would bring about a cultural renaissance in which a vast array of new artistic practices and lifestyles would flourish.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
